comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts robot-gripper hardware; this record closes a used needle's hinged safety sheath and deposits the syringe in a sharps tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual coaxial tool engagement and countertorque; the record requires one-handed surface-assisted sheath latching while avoiding the exposed needle.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained opening and lock integrity; the record checks a positively latched sheath, safe clearances, tray placement, release, and no forbidden needle contact.
comparison.reason: The record tests sharps-safe one-handed latching and disposal, with no adjustable setting or coupled screw/nut mechanics.
